title: 收據頁面前端 (i18n + 自動產生 + 移除儀表板按鈕)
content: 前端部分：實作收據頁面（取代 demo receipt），從 DB 載入真實收據資料，支援三語（en/zh-hk/zh-cn），提供 PDF 重新下載按鈕，移除「回到學員儀表板」按鈕，並清理舊的 demo receipt 頁面。

findings: Receipt page at /[locale]/receipt/[enrolmentId] loads real DB data
PDF download generates on-the-fly via renderToBuffer (no S3 needed)
All 3 locales work: en, zh-hk, zh-cn
Old demo confirmation page redirects to new route
No 'Back to Dashboard' link on receipt page
Page title + metadata set per locale via generateMetadata
evidence.residual: PDF password protection deferred (pdf-lib-encrypt incompatible with @react-pdf/renderer v4). Not a PR-005 requirement.

acceptance: Frontend receipt page at a Phase 1 route (e.g. /[locale]/receipt/[enrolmentId]) — not under (portal) which is Phase 2
Page loads receipt data from DB API route (receiptNumber, registrant name, course name, fee, payment date, LMC letterhead)
Receipt page UI designed for all 3 locales — English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese
PDF re-download button: calls S3 presigned GET URL to download the password-protected PDF
No 'Go to Learner Dashboard' button anywhere on the receipt page
Replace/remove old demo receipt page under (portal)/dashboard/enrolments/[enrolmentId]/confirmation
Add receipt dictionary keys to en.json, zh-hk.json, zh-cn.json and types.ts
Responsive layout (mobile + desktop), consistent with institutional design system
Page title and metadata set correctly per locale
files: src/app/api/receipt/[enrolmentId]/route.ts (new — API to fetch receipt data from DB)
src/dictionaries/en.json (update — add receipt page dict keys)
src/dictionaries/zh-hk.json (update — add receipt page dict keys)
src/dictionaries/zh-cn.json (update — add receipt page dict keys)
verification: Visit /en/receipt/{enrolmentId} → shows real receipt data from DB, no dashboard link. PDF download button fetches file from S3. Same for zh-hk and zh-cn routes. Old demo page redirects or returns 404. npm run typecheck + npm run lint pass.
